DDInter982.mechanism: Beta-2 adrenergic agonists can cause dose-related prolongation of the QT interval and potassium loss. Theoretically, coadministration with other agents that can prolong the QT interval may result in additive effects and increased risk of ventricular arrhythmias including torsade de pointes and sudden death. However, these effects may be more common when the drugs are administered systemically or when recommended dosages are exceeded.
